# Draft:My Talking Tom 2

My Talking Tom 2 is a free-to-play virtual pet mobile game developed and published by Outfit7 Limited. It is the sequel to My Talking Tom (2013) and was released worldwide for iOS and Android on November 6, 2018. The game was developed using the Unity game engine.
Gameplay
My Talking Tom 2 follows the virtual pet simulation format established by its predecessor. Players are tasked with caring for the cat character, Talking Tom, by managing his needs, including hunger, cleanliness, sleep, and health.
The game features enhanced three-dimensional graphics and increased interactivity compared to the original title. Players can physically interact with Tom within the game environment and participate in a variety of activities.
Key additions introduced in My Talking Tom 2 include companion pets, a travel system allowing players to visit themed virtual locations, an expanded selection of mini-games, and additional customization options for both the character and his living space. As with other entries in the Talking Tom & Friends franchise, the game includes a talk-back feature in which Tom repeats player speech using a modified voice.
Development and release
My Talking Tom 2 was developed by Outfit7 Limited using the Unity game engine. The game was released globally on November 6, 2018, for iOS and Android platforms.
Reception
Following its release, My Talking Tom 2 achieved widespread popularity on mobile platforms. Industry publications noted the game as part of Outfit7’s continued success within the virtual pet genre. PocketGamer.biz highlighted the title in discussions of the franchise’s long-term market presence, while MobileGamer.biz described the Talking Tom & Friends series as one of the largest mobile entertainment properties worldwide.
The game contributed to the overall commercial performance of the Talking Tom & Friends franchise, which has collectively surpassed 26 billion downloads worldwide.
Awards
My Talking Tom 2 received multiple industry awards between 2018 and 2019, including recognition at the Mobile Star Awards, the Tabby Awards, and the Best Mobile App Awards in categories related to mobile entertainment, family, and casual games.
Developer
Outfit7 Limited is a multinational video game developer and entertainment company founded in 2009 by Samo and Iza Login. The company is best known for creating the Talking Tom & Friends franchise, one of the most downloaded mobile game series worldwide.
The company is headquartered in Cyprus and maintains development and operational offices in Slovenia and China, with additional locations in Europe.
